about: A tool for running teams of AI coding agents that share a chat room, roles and assigned work.

prs.title: Workflow commands now show what they just did
prs.broken: After starting a workflow or handing work to the next agent, the summary said "(no instance id)", left out the new task, and told you to wait when work was ready.
prs.changed: I made the summary read the names the background service actually sends back.
prs.matters: People and agents following those hints are pointed at the right next task instead of waiting.

prs.title: Chat history now shows the latest messages
prs.broken: Once a team chat room held more messages than the display limit, its history showed the oldest ones. New messages never appeared, for people or for agents.
prs.changed: Unless you ask to start from a given message, history now returns the newest messages, still listed oldest first.
prs.matters: Agents and people catching up on a chat see what was just said, not what was said first.
